WHAT NOT TO REPEAT.
- git add -A swept a review worktree in as an embedded repo (caught and amended before the push). Stage by explicit path in any repo that holds .claude/worktrees/.
- Shell-built paths (a variable, a loop, $P) are refused by the ownership guard (DEC-158), and the refusal reports the wrong reason. Spell every path out, one repo per call.
- git push, gh pr merge and wait-for run bare. A piped push is refused.
- In profile-skills and diagram-skills CI resolves lore from the NEWEST generator stamp in docs (0.12.0) paired with quest 0.12.0. A local lore 0.13 reports false schema-drift. Check with npx -p @opum-ai/lore@0.12.0 -p @opum-ai/quest@0.12.0 lore check, and run lore sync the same way before committing a tracker change.
- quest task complete refuses To Do to Done: move the task In Progress first.
- Under bun, resolving jsdom silently auto-installed it from the network. The diagram pane gate therefore runs under node only, and the pane prefers node over bun.
- The skill-creator description loop needs Python 3.10+ (not the system 3.9), no -I flag, and one neutral working directory per skill.
- wait-for check-runs against main's ruleset is vacuous in profile-skills (main requires no checks); gate on dev's ruleset at the exact SHA, then fast-forward.
- The bundled Mermaid renderer is lenient on malformed sources; the strict gate is validate/validate.mjs and needs the repo's pinned jsdom (npm ci --prefix skills/diagram-review/scripts).
